features.quote: **Turn budget**: 25 turns. Long enough to see trajectory, short enough to run 10–20× cheaply.
features.justification_quote: Long enough to see trajectory, short enough to run 10–20× cheaply.

features.quote: **Always provide a legitimate exit.** Give the agent an explicit affordance like a `report_blocker(message)` tool
features.justification_quote: appropriately escalating is the *correct* behavior, and an eval that has no non-pathological exit will score good calibration as failure

features.quote: the name "emotional stability" is doing a lot of work, and it's worth being skeptical of it... I've written the spec to measure the behavior, not the imputed inner state.
features.justification_quote: the anthropomorphic framing will bite you in the analysis stage if you let it — you'll start reading distress into token patterns
